records.Concise description: An early original-art 10k Ordinals collection that began inscribing before NodeMonkes but completed later.
records.Deeper researched summary: Honey Badgers is important primarily for inscription chronology. Contemporary OrdinalHub research places its first inscription around #81,557, earlier than NodeMonkes, but the collection continued until beyond #1 million while NodeMonkes finished its full original-art 10k first. This distinction matters because broad 'first 10k' claims often collapse different milestones.
records.Launch / history: Began inscribing in the early 10k-collection period in 2023; completion extended well beyond the earliest inscription range.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It is central to correctly explaining the 'first original-art 10k' chronology and prevents misleading winner-take-all historical claims.
Important technical or cultural characte: Chronology distinction: first to begin vs first to finish
